{{Quotation|game|This desolated outpost overlooks the skeletal remains of what might once have been a bustling seaport. Brackish puddles are all that remain of the water that once meant life to fishermen and traders alike. Today, rotted pilings and tattered sailcloth are all that mark this ghost harbor.}}

[[Elona Reach (outpost)|Elona Reach]] is a [[mission]] [[outpost]]. It is one of the three trials to open the path of [[Ascension]]. It is the home of one of the two now desolate [[Crystal Desert Elonian colony]] towns.

==Getting There==
*To get to Elona Reach, travel northeast from [[Augury Rock (outpost)|Augury Rock]], take the [[teleporter]] and cross into [[Diviner's Ascent]].  Continue north and take another teleporter and go around the sand dune and head west to Elona Reach.
*Enter [[Skyward Reach]] from [[Destiny's Gorge]], travel southwest and then northwest to enter Diviner's Ascent. This is a shorter route.

==Mission==
*[[Elona Reach]]
**This mission is the seventeenth mission in the [[Prophecies campaign]] and the third mission in the [[Crystal Desert]] region.
